editorial.blurb: This casual spot near campus delivers authentic Indian and Sri Lankan cuisine at incredible value, with a vibrant, trendy atmosphere and an ordering kiosk for quick service.
editorial.insiderTip: Go on a weekday if you can—reviewers report 40+ minute waits on popular days like restaurant week Sundays. The curry plate is where the authentic flavors shine, and the jackfruit curry is worth trying if you're adventurous.
signatureDishes: Curry plate (3 veg curries, 1 non veg curry, rice, papad)
